trigger_note: Neptune: supersonic winds, sideways rain, the edge of everything.
speaker: Laika

lines.text: Neptune. The fastest winds in the solar system - more than 2,000 kilometres per hour, and we are standing in them.
The wind gusts sideways in bands. Lean into the blue streaks, and do not fight the gusts - time them.
Signal Antenna recovered. One call home from the edge of the system.
Antenna stowed. That is every part. Earth is waiting - assemble the ship.
When the wind lines light up, hold your ground. Move in the calm.
The saucers here are veterans: two bolts each, and they lead their shots.
Keep your jumps short in the gust bands. Long jumps become long falls.
